title: John's Pass Parasail

services.name: Johns Pass Parasail
services.desc: Over the years those who have gone parasailing have been as young as 2 and as “young” as 102. Participants under the age of 18 must have a parent or guardian sign their liability waiver. Minimum combined weight is 130-165 lbs and maximum combined weight about 450-550 lbs. Weight requirements change daily due to wind

gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Johns Pass Parasail - parasailing adventures along the Tampa Bay Beaches from Johns Pass Village and Boardwalk in Madeira Beach Florida
